question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **Coals of fire upon his head**

options.text: To shame an enemy through kindness

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Coals of fire upon his head"** means to shame an enemy or adversary through acts of kindness. (दुश्मन को दयालुता के माध्यम से शर्मिंदा करना) • **Example:** Instead of retaliating when someone insults you, showing generosity or kindness can place coals of fire upon their head. • Kindness has a powerful impact, often making others feel guilt or regret for their actions. This is the essence of this idiom. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To punish someone for hypocrisy** (किसी को पाखंड के लिए सजा देना): This option suggests retaliation for someone's dishonesty or hypocrisy, but it is not the correct meaning of the idiom. • **Example:** He exposed the hypocrisy of the politician, but he did not punish him. • **Option 2: To provoke guilt through accusation** (आरोप के माध्यम से अपराधबोध को उकसाना): This option implies making someone feel guilty by accusing them, but this is not the intent behind the idiom. • **Example:** She provoked guilt by blaming him for the mistake. • **Option 3: To offer false forgiveness** (झूठी माफी देना): This option refers to pretending to forgive someone without truly meaning it, which is unrelated to the idiom. • **Example:** He offered false forgiveness, hiding his anger beneath the surface. 37:T559, The correct answer is **option 3.**
